verses.en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.pt: Estes, pois, são os mandamentos, os estatutos e os preceitos que o Senhor teu Deus mandou ensinar-te, a fim de que os cumprisses na terra a que estás passando: para a possuíres;
verses.en_web: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it;
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the orders and the laws and the decisions which the Lord your God gave me for your teaching, so that you might do them in the land of your heritage to which you are going:

verses.en: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.pt: para que temas ao Senhor teu Deus, e guardes todos os seus estatutos e mandamentos, que eu te ordeno, tu, e teu filho, e o filho de teu filho, todos os dias da tua vida, e para que se prolonguem os teus dias.
verses.en_web: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you; you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.en_bbe: So that living in the fear of the Lord your God, you may keep all his laws and his orders, which I give you: you and your son and your son's son, all the days of your life; and so that your life may be long.

verses.en: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.pt: Ouve, pois, ó Israel, e atenta em que os guardes, para que te vá bem, e muito te multipliques na terra que mana leite e mel, como te prometeu o Senhor Deus de teus pais.
verses.en_web: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.en_bbe: So give ear, O Israel, and take care to do this; so that it may be well for you, and you may be greatly increased, as the Lord the God of your fathers has given you his word, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.en: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
verses.pt: Ouve, ó Israel; o Senhor nosso Deus é o único Senhor.
verses.en_web: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord:

verses.en: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.pt: Amarás, pois, ao Senhor teu Deus de todo o teu coração, de toda a tua alma e de todas as tuas forças.
verses.en_web: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord your God is to be loved with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

verses.en: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.pt: E estas palavras, que hoje te ordeno, estarão no teu coração;
verses.en_web: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
verses.en_bbe: Keep these words, which I say to you this day, deep in your hearts;

verses.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.pt: e as ensinarás a teus filhos, e delas falarás sentado em tua casa e andando pelo caminho, ao deitar-te e ao levantar-te.
verses.en_web: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.en_bbe: Teaching them to your children with all care, talking of them when you are at rest in your house or walking by the way, when you go to sleep and when you get up.

verses.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.pt: Também as atarás por sinal na tua mão e te serão por frontais entre os teus olhos;
verses.en_web: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
verses.en_bbe: Let them be fixed as a sign on your hand, and marked on your brow;

verses.en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.pt: e as escreverás nos umbrais de tua casa, e nas tuas portas.
verses.en_web: You shall write them on the door posts of your house, and on your gates.
verses.en_bbe: Have them lettered on the pillars of your houses and over the doors of your towns.

verses.en: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
verses.pt: Quando, pois, o Senhor teu Deus te introduzir na terra que com juramento prometeu a teus pais, Abraão, Isaque e Jacó, que te daria, com grandes e boas cidades, que tu não edificaste,
verses.en_web: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities, which you didn’t build,
verses.en_bbe: And when the Lord your God has taken you into the land which he gave his oath to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, that he would give you; with great and fair towns which were not of your building;

verses.en: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.pt: e casas cheias de todo o bem, as quais tu não encheste, e poços cavados, que tu não cavaste, vinhas e olivais, que tu não plantaste, e quando comeres e te fartares;
verses.en_web: and houses full of all good things, which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out, which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees, which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
verses.en_bbe: And houses full of good things not stored up by you, and places for storing water which you did not make, and vine-gardens and olive-trees not of your planting; and you have taken food and are full;

verses.en: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.pt: guarda-te, que não te esqueças do Senhor, que te tirou da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão.
verses.en_web: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.en_bbe: Then take care that you keep your hearts true to the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

verses.en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.pt: Temerás ao Senhor teu Deus e o servirás, e pelo seu nome jurarás.
verses.en_web: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
verses.en_bbe: Let the fear of the Lord your God be in your hearts, and be his servants, taking your oaths by his name.

verses.en: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
verses.pt: Não seguirás outros deuses, os deuses dos povos que houver à roda de ti;
verses.en_web: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you;
verses.en_bbe: Do not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples round about you;

verses.en: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.pt: porque o Senhor teu Deus é um Deus zeloso no meio de ti; para que a ira do Senhor teu Deus não se acenda contra ti, e ele te destrua de sobre a face da terra.
verses.en_web: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God; lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord your God who is with you is a God who will not let his honour be given to another; or the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, causing your destruction from the face of the earth.

verses.en: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
verses.pt: Não tentareis o Senhor vosso Deus, como o tentastes em Massá.
verses.en_web: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put the Lord your God to the test as you did in Massah.

verses.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.pt: Diligentemente guardarás os mandamentos do Senhor teu Deus, como também os seus testemunhos, e seus estatutos, que te ordenou.
verses.en_web: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep with care the orders of the Lord your God, and his rules and his laws which he has given you;

verses.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
verses.pt: Também praticarás o que é reto e bom aos olhos do Senhor, para que te vá bem, e entres, e possuas a boa terra, a qual o Senhor prometeu com juramento a teus pais;
verses.en_web: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight; that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,
verses.en_bbe: And do what is upright and good in the eyes of the Lord your God, so that it may be well for you and you may go in and take for your heritage that good land from which the Lord undertook by an oath to your fathers,

verses.en: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.pt: para que lance fora de diante de ti todos os teus inimigos, como disse o Senhor.
verses.en_web: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
verses.en_bbe: To send out from before you all those who are against you.

verses.en: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
verses.pt: Quando teu filho te perguntar no futuro, dizendo: Que significam os testemunhos, estatutos e preceitos que o Senhor nosso Deus vos ordenou?
verses.en_web: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”
verses.en_bbe: And when your son says to you in time to come, What is the reason for these rules and laws and decisions which the Lord our God has given you?

verses.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.pt: responderás a teu filho: Éramos servos de Faraó no Egito, porém o Senhor, com mão forte, nos tirou de lá;
verses.en_web: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
verses.en_bbe: Then you will say to your son, We were servants under Pharaoh's yoke in Egypt; and the Lord took us out of Egypt with a strong hand:

verses.en: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.pt: e, aos nossos olhos, o Senhor fez sinais e maravilhas grandes e penosas contra o Egito, contra Faraó e contra toda a sua casa;
verses.en_web: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord did great signs and wonders against Egypt, and against Pharaoh and all his house, before our eyes:

verses.en: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.pt: mas nos tirou de lá, para nos introduzir e nos dar a terra que com juramento prometera a nossos pais.
verses.en_web: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
verses.en_bbe: And he took us out from that place, guiding us here to give us this land, as he said in his oath to our fathers.

verses.en: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor nos ordenou que observássemos todos estes estatutos, que temêssemos o Senhor nosso Deus, para o nosso bem em todo o tempo, a fim de que ele nos preservasse em vida, assim como hoje se vê.
verses.en_web: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave us orders to keep all these laws, in the fear of the Lord our God, so that it might be well for us for ever, and that he might keep us from death, as he has done to this day.

verses.en: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.pt: E será justiça para nós, se tivermos cuidado de cumprir todos estes mandamentos perante o Senhor nosso Deus, como ele nos ordenou.
verses.en_web: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”
verses.en_bbe: And it will be our righteousness if we take care to keep all this order before the Lord our God as he has given it to us.
